rules.statement: A vendor is liable for eviction, whether the whole thing has been evicted or only a part, provided it be a part of the thing and homogeneous with it, and a real servitude is a 'homogeneous part.'
rules.supporting_quote: "Before dealing with the other covenants, I may state that under the Roman-Dutch law a vendor is liable for eviction, whether the whole thing has been evicted or only a part, provided it be a part of the thing and homogeneous with it, and a real servitude is a 'homogeneous part.'"
